settings.bands.label: Number of bars
settings.bands.description: How many spectrum bars to draw. Must match the generated cava config (reloads automatically).
settings.bar_max_height.label: Max bar height (px)
settings.bar_max_height.description: Tallest a bar can grow, in logical pixels.
settings.row_height.label: Row height (px)
settings.row_height.description: Fixed height of the bar row. Must equal the widget box_height so the bars stay pinned to the bottom edge.
settings.spacing.label: Bar spacing (px)
settings.radius.label: Corner radius (px)
settings.bar_color.label: Bar color
settings.bar_color.description: Palette role or hex color for the bars.
settings.bar_opacity.label: Bar opacity
settings.hide_when_idle.label: Hide when no audio
settings.hide_when_idle.description: Fade the bars out when nothing is playing.
settings.hide_with_windows.label: Hide when a window is open
settings.hide_with_windows.description: Hides the bars while the current workspace has any window. Needs niri and jq installed.
settings.box_width.label: Box width (px)
settings.box_width.description: Width used to lay the bars out; keep it equal to the widget box_width.
